newsitem.title: USA: Aetna says Q3 EPS estimate excludes charge.
newsitem.headline: Aetna says Q3 EPS estimate excludes charge.

text.p: Aetna Inc said on Friday that analysts' estimate of $0.95 for its third quarter earnings per share excludes the company's previously announced after-tax restructuring charge of $31.8 million.
It earlier reported net earnings per share excluding the charge of $0.95, against $0.97 in the third quarter of 1995.
Including the charge and $5.2 million in net realized capital gains, income per share from continuing operations for the third quarter was $0.77 per share.
In the 1995 quarter, the company reported $0.98 per share, including $1.5 million in net realized capital gains.
